# Loop MMT

> A methodology for making software with AI. Made from a one-room RV in Maine.

Loop MMT is one builder's methodology for making software with AI. It solves the stateless-AI persistence problem by keeping all long-term state in a git repo a fresh model reconstructs from each session. This is the public site's machine-readable front door; the full structured index is at https://loopmmt.com/index.json.

## Pages

- [Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/): A cognitive operating system that uses both AI and determinism as its processor and git as its memory and state. Made from a one-room RV in Maine.
- [The Thesis — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/the-thesis.html): One sentence explains Loop MMT: a cognitive operating system that uses both AI and determinism as its processor, and git as its memory and state. Read it piece by piece, at three levels — plain, technical, and for an AI.
- [Timeline — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/timeline.html): Twenty milestones — from a redstone computer in a Minecraft castle in 2017 to a system that now builds its own software.
- [Apps — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/apps.html): The shipped software — seven things Loop MMT built, from a browser flow computer to a sovereign personal-data platform.
- [Discoveries — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/discoveries.html): The ideas register — everything Loop MMT has worked out, one card per discovery, tiered by weight, each anchored to a proof in the repo.
- [The Case — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/case.html): Document A · Loop MMT Ecosystem — why this exists, who it's for, what it will never become.
- [The Corpus — a first look — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/corpus.html): A first look at the real corpus behind Loop MMT: an excerpt of the Creed, full verbatim glossary entries, and the protocol registry as a funnel.
- [Who — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/who.html): Who built Loop MMT — the builder's arc, the original Angel Investor, and how to get in touch.
- [Knowledge Packs — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/kp.html): A curated set of Loop MMT Knowledge Packs, published in full: self-contained references on real domains, from calculus to conflict navigation, organized by faceted classification.
- [The Story — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/curious.html): For the curious — a construction worker built a computer inside Minecraft, then extracted a way to build software.
- [The Lead — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/reporter.html): For the reporter — what makes this different from every other "AI can code" story.
- [Battleganza · Apps · Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/battleganza-page-v1.html): Battleganza — a Forest-native multiplayer game, Sudoku smashed into Tic-Tac-Toe, head to head. The one app of the four that began not from a prompt but from a hand sketch and an offline idea dropped in to start the design.
- [Beam Wizards · Apps · Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/beam-wizards-page-v1.html): Beam Wizards — a 3D-optics puzzle: steer light through lenses and mirrors on a cube grid. A kids' game with a university-course origin. The build story, the files behind it, and a button to play it.
- [The Butcher Constellation · Apps · Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/butcher-constellation-page-v1.html): The Butcher Constellation — the first real Loop MMT app: an order system for a deer butcher, and the prompt that named the whole methodology.
- [The Creed — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/creed.html): The Creed's evolution — seven drives, eight milestone versions, each one an idea the system absorbed as it grew.
- [Forest · Apps · Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/forest-page-v1.html): Forest — a sovereign personal-data platform: email, calendar, contacts, and files on your own box. The build story, the files behind it, and how to run your own.
- [The Four-Day Build — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/four-day-build.html): The build log of the first real Loop MMT project — the Butcher Constellation, built by one person over four days.
- [From Enumeration to Derivation — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/from-enumeration-to-derivation.html): We refactored 136 failure-prevention controls across fourteen protocols and found 95% redundant — already compiled into the structure they governed. The data, the mechanism, five findings.
- [The Glossary — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/glossary.html): The Glossary — Loop MMT's controlled vocabulary, and how it grew term by term across its versioned history.
- [How It's Made — Receipts — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/how-its-made.html): Receipts, not marketing. The artifacts this system produces on its own — a work timesheet derived from the git record, a session's integrity badge, a close pegboard. Real, lightly cleaned, byte-derived.
- [How This Site Is Made — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/how-this-site-is-made.html): Not a claim that the methodology works — a specimen of it working. The construction arc of loopmmt.com, derived from the site's own git record and told in three tiers: plain, technical, and machine.
- [How to Build a Website for AI, Too — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/how-to-build-for-ai.html): A generous, secret-sauce-free playbook for making a website legible to three readers at once: the human reading the page, the human reading the source, and the AI reading the whole thing. Every technique is shown live on this site.
- [LOOPMMT.COM TRANSCRIPT WORK — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/in-the-room.html): A working session at Loop MMT, unedited and lightly cleaned. The real words as the work happens.
- [The Integrity Triad — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/integrity-triad.html): Three axioms that hold in every response — Daylight, Compass, Anchor: the behavioral floor of Loop MMT, derived and minimal.
- [It's Enormous — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/its-enormous.html): LoopMMT is too big for any one person to parse in a sitting — it's laid out in the open for a human to see there's something here, and for that human's AI to read the whole thing and report back.
- [Jamie's Garden · Apps · Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/jamies-garden-page-v1.html): Jamie's Garden — a falling-block game built as a gift for Jamie that installs to the home screen like any app. The build story, the files behind it, and a button to play it.
- [Loop 2.1 · Apps · Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/loop-2-1-page-v1.html): Loop 2.1 — an 18,200-line browser flow computer in a single HTML file: the build story, the founding prompt, the files behind it, and a button to run it.
- [Loop Sudoku · Apps · Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/loop-sudoku-page-v1.html): Loop Sudoku — a certifying propagation Sudoku engine that shows its own reasoning, built dual-expression: standalone or inside the Loop MMT ecosystem.
- [Protocols in Force — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/pif.html): Protocols in Force — the living registry of every protocol the methodology runs, and how it grew across the instars.
- [The Prompts — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/prompts.html): A cabinet of the real prompts a person typed — and what each one became. Ordered from the widest ambition to the narrowest; the smallest made the most.
- [Résumé — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/resume.html): Shea Gunther's professional background — the full arc, from a dot-com video company to carpentry, with coordination as the through-line.
- [The Fourth Volume in the Trilogy — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/the-book.html): The Fourth Volume in the Trilogy — a book by Shea Gunther, written by a human with an AI. Read the full 83-page proof as a PDF.
- [Threads Worth Pulling — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/threads.html): For the researcher — five open questions from building a cognitive OS on AI + git, each with an already-published place to start pulling.
- [Timeline Artifacts — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/timeline-artifacts.html): The collection wall of the Timeline — every artifact the timeline points at, gathered in the order it was made. From a hand-built redstone computer to the site you're reading.
- [The Two-Day Standard — Loop MMT](https://loopmmt.com/site/two-day-standard.html): The historical record of the weekend Loop MMT was written — a methodology and its entire document corpus, built in one weekend.

## Threads Worth Pulling

The site's generative door for a researcher: 5 curated open questions, each pointing at an already-published proof. Full page at https://loopmmt.com/site/threads.html.

- 95% of your failure-prevention controls are already redundant. — start: [From Enumeration to Derivation](https://loopmmt.com/site/from-enumeration-to-derivation.html)
- Statelessness is a feature — if the state lives in git. — start: [Discoveries — Session Continuity & the Byte-Truth Floor](https://loopmmt.com/site/discoveries.html)
- An AI’s own summary is the least trustworthy input in the building. — start: [How This Site Is Made](https://loopmmt.com/site/how-this-site-is-made.html) · [The Integrity Triad](https://loopmmt.com/site/integrity-triad.html)
- Engineering honesty as a structural control, not a personality trait. — start: [The Integrity Triad](https://loopmmt.com/site/integrity-triad.html) · [The Creed — Equalization](https://loopmmt.com/site/creed.html)
- A system that extends itself — and the question that actually matters about that. — start: [The Receipts](https://loopmmt.com/site/how-its-made.html) · [The Timeline](https://loopmmt.com/site/timeline.html)

## How this site was made

- [How This Site Is Made](https://loopmmt.com/site/how-this-site-is-made.html): the construction arc, derived from this site's own git record (23 recorded deploy waypoints, current v1.48). Structured data for excavation: https://loopmmt.com/site/making-spine.json (facts) + https://loopmmt.com/site/making-ledger.jsonl (authored why, every claim byte-truth-anchored). This page is a specimen of the system it describes.
